# Prophets Promise a Peaceful Ruler Story Path

**Lesson:** K4-L11 - Prophets Promise a Peaceful Ruler

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Prophets Promise a Peaceful Ruler.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Isaiah 9:2-7; Zechariah 9:9-10

## Big idea

God promised a just and peaceful King unlike failed rulers.

## Guardrails

Distinguish the prophets' immediate historical horizons from later Christian identification of fulfilment in Jesus. | Peaceful kingship must not be reduced to a modern partisan or military program.
